## Description

Please describe your change and link any related issue. Keep it focused: one
logical change per pull request.

## Type of change

- [ ] New page or feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] SEO or metadata update
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] PWA or service worker change
- [ ] Refactor or cleanup

## How has this been tested

Describe how you verified the change:

- [ ] Opened the touched page in a browser
- [ ] Checked both light and dark theme (if the page uses hig.css)
- [ ] Confirmed JSON-LD blocks parse as valid JSON
- [ ] Confirmed no broken internal links were introduced
- [ ] Confirmed no em dashes or emojis in content

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots showing the before and after.

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the contributing style guide
- [ ] I updated sitemap.xml and _redirects if I added a page
- [ ] I bumped the service worker CACHE_VERSION if I changed page assets
- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines
